---
title: "Resources"
---

This page contains a non-exhaustive list of resources for learning R with a focus on epidemiology in humanitarian settings. 

**Want to add some other resources?** Suggestions and contributions are welcome! Please [open an issue](https://github.com/epicentre-msf/repicentre/issues) or get in touch.

<br>

#### R Programming

- [DataCamp — Introduction to R](https://www.datacamp.com/courses/free-introduction-to-r). Interactive and beginner-friendly introduction to R.

- [Posit Cloud Primers](https://posit.cloud/learn/primers). Browser-based interactive R tutorials covering the basics through to data visualisation and iteration.

- [R for Data Science](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/). A good introduction to the tidyverse, covering data import, transformation,
  visualisation, and communication.

- [Advanced R](https://adv-r.hadley.nz/). Deep dive into R's internals and programming patterns.

<br>

#### Focus: Epidemiology and Statistics

- [The Epidemiologist R Handbook](https://epirhandbook.com/). An excellent resource for applied epidemiology in R. Written with field epidemiologists in mind, it covers outbreak investigation, survey analysis, GIS mapping, automated reporting, and more. Available in multiple languages.

- [Introduction to R for Health Data Science](https://argoshare.is.ed.ac.uk/healthyr_book/). Focused on health data, includes survival analysis and logistic regression.

- [Statistical Inference via Data Science](https://moderndive.com/). Gentle introduction to statistical thinking with R and the tidyverse.

- [The MSF-Epicentre Github](https://github.com/epicentre-msf). Provides a number of publicly available packages tailored to the specific needs of of MSF epidemiologists.

- [`{sitrep}`](https://github.com/R4EPI/sitrep). Developed by R4EPIs / MSF. Templates and functions for situation reports in outbreak and survey contexts.

- [R4EPIs Project](https://r4epis.netlify.app/). MSF & RECON initiative providing standardised R templates and tutorials for field epidemiology: outbreak investigation, mortality surveys, and vaccination coverage surveys.

<br>

#### Focus: Surveys and Needs Assessments

- [`{srvyr}`](https://cran.r-project.org/package=srvyr). Tidyverse-style analysis tools for complex survey data (cluster sampling, stratification, weights). Particularly useful for SMART nutrition surveys, mortality surveys, and other humanitarian assessments. This package is based off of [`{survey}`](https://cran.r-project.org/package=survey).

- [Exploring Complex Survey Data Analysis Using R](https://tidy-survey-r.github.io/tidy-survey-book/). A useful text providing an in depth look at using `{srvyr}` and `{survey}`


<br>

#### Focus: GIS & Mapping

- [Geocomputation with R](https://r.geocompx.org/). Full guide to spatial data analysis and mapping in R.

<br>

#### Focus: Reporting & Reproducibility

- [Quarto](https://quarto.org/docs/guide/) — A rich text format well suited for reproducible and automated reporting. Quarto supports reports, websites, and even simple dashboards.
